Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.

1.

The prayer in the instant petition is for a direction to the respondent authorities, not to interfere in the remaining area measuring 0.5780 hectgare of gata no. 240M, village Dhanauri (Dankaur),
Tehsil Sadar, District Gautam Budh Nagar belonging to the petitioners and decide their representation dated 16.10.2024 filed in this behalf.

sentences.text: Concededly, some part of the land of the petitioners was acquired under the provisions of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 in the year 2009-2010 and the compensation therefor was duly paid.
Possession of the said land was obtained by the authority on 28.06.2011.
The specific case of the authority is that it is only in possession of the acquired land and is not interfering in the possession of the petitioners in respect of the remaining area.

3. Having regard to the rival contentions, it seems that there is a dispute between them relating to demarcation and identity of the remaining land, for which the petitioner has remedy under Section 24 of the U.P. Revenue Code, 2006.
4. Accordingly, the instant petition is disposed of with liberty to the petitioners to get their land demarcated, if so advised in appropriate proceedings.
(Anish Kumar Gupta, J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta, J.) Order Date :- 7.11.2024/
